newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy would give a speech at the European Parliament on Wednesday at 1500/1300 GMT on the Amsterdam European Council and the Denver summit results. He said Commission President Jacques Santer would also address the EP on Thursday at 0930/0730 GMT.
Vale de Almeida said Commissioner Emma Bonino would hold a news conference at 1215/1015 GMT on Thursday on fish and aquaculture processing.

Spokeswoman Elisabetta Olivi briefed on the patent system in Europe. She said that in the green paper it adopted on June 24, the Commission judged the system to be expensive, complicated and hard to access. The Commission hopes to reach a system at Community level that would ensure similar effects in all Member States, Olivi said.

Spokeswoman Barbara Nolan said the Belfast European Partnership Board would meet over the next two days. She said it was financed by the European Commission and local government and that its task was to select and fund proposals aimed at helping the city. Nolan said the BEPB chairman would be available to reporters on Thursday at 1215/1015 GMT.
Spokesman Josep Coll i Carbo briefed on Thursday's General Affairs Council.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/553: The growth and environment loan guarantee pilot programme is operational.
- IP/97/558: Patents: Commission approves green paper.
- IP/97/559: Conference on fish and aquaculture processing to be held in Brussels on 26 and 27 June.
- IP/97/560: Commissioner Pinheiro meets U.N. Secretary General Kofi Annan.
- IP/97/561: Joao de Deus Pinheiro spells out six principles for conflict prevention in Africa.
